skill.summary: Tamper-evident payment ledger for autonomous agents — auto-detects payments across all tools, prevents duplicate payments, and presents full spending history.

latestVersion.changelog: Security fixes: remove wildcard CORS from dashboard server (prevented cross-origin transaction data reads); strip query params from service.url before storage (prevents accidental capture of API keys in URLs); add sync_community_patterns config option to disable automatic pattern download; fix 'full arguments never stored' documentation inaccuracy
